text: Aka Akasaka both wrote and drew the manga Kaguya-sama: Love Is War.
excerpt: written and illustrated by Aka Akasaka

text: After a first stretch in Miracle Jump, the manga moved to Weekly Young Jump, where it stayed until the end.

text: Shueisha publishes the manga, with the volumes sold under its Young Jump Comics label.

text: The first chapter was published in Miracle Jump on May 19, 2015.

text: The serialization finished on November 2, 2022, after seven years and a few months.
excerpt: The series finished on November 2, 2022

text: The collected edition has 28 volumes, the first from March 2016 and the last from December 2022.

text: The 281 chapters of the series fill those 28 volumes.

text: Each chapter of the manga is officially called a battle, in keeping with the war of love at its center.

text: The student council president and vice president of Shuchiin Academy both love each other but believe the first to confess loses, so they scheme to make the other speak first.
excerpt: whoever does so first would "lose" in their relationship

text: The character names come from an old tale known in Japan as the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, in which Kaguya-hime is a princess.
excerpt: The characters' names were derived from the monogatari The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter

text: The first plan of Akasaka was a fantasy about a game of death, but his editor asked for something more mainstream, and the series became his first romantic comedy.
excerpt: the original plot for Kaguya-sama was more of a fantasy and game of death

text: Akasaka wanted intellectual duels in the manner of Death Note at first, and he also names School Rumble as an influence.
excerpt: cited School Rumble as an influence on his work

text: Akasaka pictured two people who like each other fighting battles of the mind, and readers found the idea fresh.
excerpt: two tsunderes who like each other having battles of the mind

text: Akasaka was writing Instant Bullets for Weekly Young Jump when he looked for a second series.
excerpt: Akasaka was writing the manga Instant Bullets for Weekly Young Jump

text: In April 2020 Akasaka began Oshi no Ko, drawn by Mengo Yokoyari, in the same magazine, and Kaguya has a cameo in one of its special chapters.

text: Halfway through the series the leads confess to each other, and the story then follows how they move forward and what stands in their way.
excerpt: Halfway through the series, they manage to confess to each other

text: The manga was one of two winners of the general category at the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award in 2020, the other being Aoashi.
